baseline_capacity_envelope.source: Phase 3 frozen A0 daily_nav planned_members after each signal-close decision

capacity_application_contract.position_sizing: unchanged frozen 10% target weight per desired member
capacity_application_contract.selection: each matched arm uses its own eligible candidates and frozen RS ordering
capacity_application_contract.survivor_overflow: do not invent capacity-triggered exits; preserve survivor-first and all frozen exits; admit zero new names while surviving targets exceed the A0 envelope and report every overflow day

extra_candidate_quality_definition.extra_entry: filled BUY with new_position=true whose persisted entry evaluation has the removed module diagnostic=false on the same signal date
extra_candidate_quality_definition.return_statistics_population: completed FIFO round trips among selected extra episodes
extra_candidate_quality_definition.selected_extra_candidate_count: all such filled new-position entry episodes

interpretation_contract.rule: Do not infer module value from total return alone. Restoration after matching supports opportunity/exposure control; persistent weakness and low capture supports security-selection or crowd-out protection; conflicting dimensions require MIXED or INCONCLUSIVE.

offline_winner_crowdout.finite_capacity_definition: remaining-condition eligible episode not selected because all slots were occupied or higher frozen-RS candidates filled every vacancy
